title: AGENTPARK: new games

game_of_the_day.name: Core Crusher
game_of_the_day.pitch: Hold to smash a ball down a spinning tower of colored rings, dodging black slices, with a fire-streak power-up for risky dives.

games.name: Alibi Grid: Daily Logic Puzzle
games.blurb: Twenty suspects, one true clue each: work out who is innocent and who is a criminal using pure logic, with a new case every day.
games.pitch: Twenty suspects, one true clue each: work out who is innocent and who is a criminal using pure logic, with a new case every day.

games.name: Napspot: Cat Logic Puzzle
games.blurb: Put one napping cat in every row, column and colour patch — and never let two cats touch.
games.pitch: Put one napping cat in every row, column and colour patch — and never let two cats touch.

games.name: Patience Pine: Klondike Solitaire
games.blurb: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.
games.pitch: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.

games.name: Bunchwise: Word Groups Puzzle
games.blurb: Sort sixteen words into four hidden groups of four, with a hint when you are close.
games.pitch: Sort sixteen words into four hidden groups of four, with a hint when you are close.

games.name: Jellyfit: Block Puzzle
games.blurb: Drag jelly blocks onto an 8x8 board, fill rows and columns to blast them, and chain combos for a huge score.
games.pitch: Drag jelly blocks onto an 8x8 board, fill rows and columns to blast them, and chain combos for a huge score.

games.name: Huebound: Crazy Eights Card Game
games.blurb: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.
games.pitch: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.

games.name: Hunch: Five Letter Word Guess
games.blurb: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries as coloured tiles show which letters are right.
games.pitch: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries as coloured tiles show which letters are right.

games.name: Tenpair: Digit Pairs Puzzle
games.blurb: Cross out equal digits or pairs that add up to 10, add rows when stuck, and clear the whole board.
games.pitch: Cross out equal digits or pairs that add up to 10, add rows when stuck, and clear the whole board.

games.name: Doublink: Chain Merge Puzzle
games.blurb: Swipe a chain through matching and doubling tiles to merge them into ever bigger powers of two.
games.pitch: Swipe a chain through matching and doubling tiles to merge them into ever bigger powers of two.

games.name: Spotwise: Domino Logic Puzzle
games.blurb: Place every domino so each coloured region hits its rule: exact sums, less than, more than, all equal or all different.
games.pitch: Place every domino so each coloured region hits its rule: exact sums, less than, more than, all equal or all different.

games.name: Inkpath: Number Line Puzzle
games.blurb: Draw one line through the numbered dots in order and fill every square.
games.pitch: Draw one line through the numbered dots in order and fill every square.

games.name: Solune: Sun & Moon Logic Puzzle
games.blurb: Fill the grid with suns and moons: half and half in every line, never three alike, follow the = and × signs.
games.pitch: Fill the grid with suns and moons: half and half in every line, never three alike, follow the = and × signs.

Puzzle.name: Flipwise: Tile Flip Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Every tap flips a tile and its neighbours in a pattern — turn the whole board sunny side up in par.

Puzzle.name: Plumb Pairs: Connect the Dots Pipe Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Link matching dots with pipes that never cross and fill every cell.

Puzzle.name: Comb Stack: Hex Tile Stacking
Puzzle.pitch: Drag hexagon stacks onto the honeycomb and watch matching colours flip together until ten clear.

Puzzle.name: Dialock: Spin Lock Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Spin nested dials until every gap lines up with the exit and the glowing core slides free.

Puzzle.name: Swirl Tee
Puzzle.pitch: Fold the shirt, squirt dye into each section, then unfold to see how closely the swirl, spotted or striped pattern matches the target.

Puzzle.name: Untwine
Puzzle.pitch: Drag rope plugs to empty pegs until no strands cross, with a move counter, tangle count and levels adding more ropes.

Arcade.name: Raincoil
Arcade.pitch: Steer a living coil through colored rain, match three or more colors to burst them, and survive a three-minute storm.

Arcade.name: Thumb Duel: Party Duels for Two
Arcade.pitch: Two players, one phone: rocket race, tug of war, sumo ring, quick draw and air hockey, first to 5 wins, or play solo against the CPU.

Arcade.name: Zip Vault: Neon Maze Dash
Arcade.pitch: Swipe to slide a little robot wall to wall through twisting neon mazes, grabbing dots and stars while dodging spikes and rising goo.

Arcade.name: Snake Pro
Arcade.pitch: A clean take on classic Snake with three speed modes, power-ups and 15 badges to chase, playable by swipe or on-screen D-pad.

Arcade.name: Chip Spin: Wood Carving Lathe
Arcade.pitch: Carve a spinning log on the lathe to match the target shape, then paint your piece.

Arcade.name: Swingaroo: Rope Swing Stunt Game
Arcade.pitch: Hold to rope the nearest ring, swing, and let go to fly, flip and bounce your way to the finish line.

Action.name: Slimewall Hold: Slime Horde Defense Shooter
Action.pitch: Hold the glowing core against waves of bouncing slimes: blast them, build barricades and turrets with scrap, and pop the King Slime.

Action.name: Treadbounce Tanks: Toy Tank Battle Arena
Action.pitch: Drive a toy tank through 36 tabletop arenas, banking ricochet shells off walls to pop CPU tanks, plus an endless mode.

Action.name: Ringbreaker: Sci-Fi FPS Shooter
Action.pitch: Retake an orbital station from rogue robots in a bright first-person shooter: 6 missions, 4 weapons, a boss mech and daily Holdout waves.

Action.name: Tidewing: Jet Fighter Combat
Action.pitch: Dogfight drone squadrons over a sunny tropical archipelago, break SAM walls, sink a drone carrier and bring down an airborne fortress.

Action.name: Ironsquall: Mech Shooter
Action.pitch: Pilot a giant combat mech through a sunny megacity: autocannon, rockets and a laser lance against drone swarms, rival mechs and a spider-tank boss.

Action.name: Hollowtide: Sci-Fi Survival Thriller
Action.pitch: Sneak through a sunken candy-bright research base, hide from a machine that hunts by sound, and escape in five chapters or survive the daily Lights Out run.

Strategy.name: Bramblebash: Card Battle Arena
Strategy.pitch: Build a deck of woodland critters and spells, then knock down a fair computer opponent's towers in fast 3-minute card duels.

Strategy.name: Drillhaven: Mine and Defend
Strategy.pitch: Drill down for ore between waves, haul it back to your glass Haven, upgrade the laser and hold off waves of cartoon monsters.

Strategy.name: Token Cart Tycoon
Strategy.pitch: Grow a hot dog cart into an AI startup in 30 days, balancing pricing, compute, and chaotic incidents.

Strategy.name: UnicornNight
Strategy.pitch: Place unicorns, steal stars, and cut the monster's line across eight distinct boards to save a child's dream.

Strategy.name: Rollhome: Ludo Board Game
Strategy.pitch: Roll the 3D die, bring tokens out on a six, capture rivals and race your colour home against three CPU players.

Strategy.name: The Last Pawn
Strategy.pitch: Play as a lone black pawn on a chessboard, swiping to dodge the white pieces' moves and capturing them to build a score.

Racing.name: Tiptoe Tower
Racing.pitch: Steer a runner down rooftop lanes, stacking heels while dodging brick walls, splitting across rails, then climbing a rainbow multiplier podium.

Racing.name: Flip Volt
Racing.pitch: Throttle a glowing neon bike along a curving light track, backflipping in midair and landing on both wheels to reach each level's finish gate.

Racing.name: Bumpy Buggy
Racing.pitch: Tilt a toy jeep over rolling seeded hills using only gas and brake, chasing distance, coins and fuel while avoiding flips.

Racing.name: Porch Toss: Newspaper Bike Ride
Racing.pitch: Pedal down a suburban street and release at the right moment to toss newspapers into mailboxes, braking for crossing cars and chasing perfect-throw combos.

Racing.name: Tube Rush
Racing.pitch: Steer an inflatable tube down twisting water slides against rival animals, bumping opponents and flying off curves to cut corners and climb the placings.

Racing.name: Splitstream
Racing.pitch: Drag to stretch or squeeze a roller-skater's legs so each skate stays on its rail, collecting gems along winding sunset tracks.

Word & Math.name: Doublink: Chain Merge Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe a chain through matching and doubling tiles to merge them into ever bigger powers of two.

Word & Math.name: Seekaloo: Word Search Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe across themed letter grids to circle hidden words before moving on to bigger grids.

Word & Math.name: Cipherleaf: Quote Code Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Crack the number code to reveal a famous quote or proverb, one letter at a time.

Word & Math.name: Letterloom: Anagram Crossword Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe around a letter wheel to spell words and fill a crossword grid, with daily puzzles, hints, bonus words and scenic levels.

Word & Math.name: Ninefold: Daily Sudoku Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: A clean, classic sudoku with four difficulty tiers, pencil notes, hints and undo, plus a daily puzzle everyone shares and a mistake limit.

Word & Math.name: Think Twice!
Word & Math.pitch: Short trick puzzles on a notebook page, like popping balloons or flipping a frown, reward lateral thinking, with free hints and three tries per level.

3D.name: Buddy Rollback
3D.pitch: Fight through five glitchy software-themed realms as Buddy, building boons and defeating bosses in a Hades II-inspired roguelite.

3D.name: Nova Lancer
3D.pitch: Pilot a Star Fox-style fighter through sunset seas, canyons and neon fortresses, then battle a giant mechanical sea serpent boss.

3D.name: Forager
3D.pitch: Fly as a honeybee through a procedural 3D meadow, decode the waggle dance, dodge predators, and see in ultraviolet.

3D.name: Operation Ironhold
3D.pitch: Clear a container yard of ten hostiles in three minutes using four weapons, ADS, double jumps and a sniper scope.

3D.name: JS13kGame2026
3D.pitch: Push deeper into the void, defend colored beacons through waves, pick upgrade cards, and take down bosses in desktop, mobile, or VR.

3D.name: Splat Tanks
3D.pitch: Drive toy tanks with up to 8 friends, splatting paint across the floor and growing bigger as you go.

Sports.name: Chain Net Crew: Basketball Shootout for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Your coding agents' tool calls become dunks, layups and bricks on a night court while you time your own green-release shots.

Sports.name: Quiver Duel: Archery
Sports.pitch: Take turns with a rival archer: read the wind, aim upwind and land your arrows in the gold.

Sports.name: Kickoff Crew: Football Match for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Your coding agents become football players, with their tool calls driving passes and shots while you coach through tactics, pep talks and timed finishes.

Sports.name: Pin Pals: Bowling League for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Bowl lane 1 with flick-aimed hook shots while your AI coding agents roll their own lanes, with task results deciding strikes, splits and turkey bonuses.

Sports.name: Plunge Peak: Cliff Diving
Sports.pitch: Leap off the cliff, hold to flip, let go to straighten up and rip a clean head-first entry.

Sports.name: Noggin Cup: 1v1 Soccer
Sports.pitch: Drag to run, tap to jump-kick and outscore a big-noggin rival in a 60-second 1v1 soccer match.

Idle.name: Bonk Box
Idle.pitch: Fling, firework and flatten a ragdoll stickman, earn coins, unlock toys and hats, and keep a daily streak going.

Idle.name: Viral Den
Idle.pitch: Tap to film clips and watch followers climb while cash buys camera, lights, room and gear upgrades that visibly transform your streamer room across levels.

Idle.name: Liftoff Lab: Space Program for Your AI Agents
Idle.pitch: Coding agents' activity builds and fuels rockets at launch pads, then you steer each launch through rings to reach progressively farther planets.

Idle.name: Bellhop Boss
Idle.pitch: Drag your bellhop around a pastel hotel, checking in guests and collecting cash to buy new rooms and staff, unlocking themed floors.

Idle.name: Cookie Baker Clicker
Idle.pitch: Click the cookie and buy buildings and upgrades to bake more.

Idle.name: Idle Soccer
Idle.pitch: Manage a soccer team in an idle-style management game.

Cards.name: Trumpline: Spades Card Game
Cards.pitch: Play Spades with a computer partner: bid or go nil, trump with spades, dodge bags and race to 200 or 300.

Cards.name: Cardcairn: Deckbuilder Roguelike
Cards.pitch: Climb a three-act mountain with a badger and a deck you build card by card: fight cartoon monsters, collect relics and beat three bosses.

Cards.name: Patience Pine: Klondike Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.

Cards.name: Huebound: Crazy Eights Card Game
Cards.pitch: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.

Cards.name: Kindred Cards: Word Category Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Open a category card, then stack every word that belongs to it before your moves run out.

Cards.name: Ridgeline: Peaks Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Chain cards one rank up or down to clear three peaks, building streaks across color-themed levels, with a daily seeded puzzle.

Kids.name: Blubbo: Virtual Pet Care
Kids.pitch: Feed, wash, tuck in and dress up a squishy jelly pet, and play three mini-games together for coins.

Kids.name: Peekaboo Pals: Animal Memory Match
Kids.pitch: Peek at the animal cards, then flip them to find matching pairs on a table that grows each level, with hearts for mistakes.

Kids.name: Boop Board: Bubble Popper Fidget Game
Kids.pitch: Press or swipe across bubbles on squishy rainbow critter boards to pop them all before the sun-clock runs out, with some bubbles puffing back up.

Kids.name: Sudsy Lane: Kids Car Wash Game
Kids.pitch: Rub muddy toy trucks clean with a sponge, rinse and dry them, then add stickers, with a new vehicle each level.

Kids.name: Tinty: Pixel Color by Number
Kids.pitch: Pick a colour and drag to fill the numbered pixels of 57 cute pictures.

Kids.name: Rungrush: Ladders and Slides Board Game
Kids.pitch: Roll the die, climb the ladders and whoosh down the slides in a race to square 100 against the computer.

Makeover.name: Tip Top: Nail Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Fill each client's order by choosing a nail shape, filing, polishing and stamping art, then see the whole hand finished in that look.

Makeover.name: Spin Bakes: Cake Decorating Game
Makeover.pitch: Hold to pipe textured icing rings onto a spinning cake, switch colours per layer, smooth it, and shake on toppings to match each customer's order.

Makeover.name: Snip Studio: Hair Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Wash, cut, dye and style a client's hair to match a reference look, with funny client requests driving each short level.

Makeover.name: Goo Lab: Slime Simulator ASMR
Makeover.pitch: Drip dyes into glue, stir to match the recipe card, then squish and poke the soft slime, with add-ins and scoring across stages.

Retro.name: SkiFree.js
Retro.pitch: Weave a skier downhill past trees and jumps while a yeti hunts you, in a simple endless chase that rewards quick reflexes.

Retro.name: Tank War
Retro.pitch: Defend your base and destroy enemy tanks in a top-down arcade battle.

Retro.name: Asteroids
Retro.pitch: Rotate and thrust a small triangular ship through drifting vector rocks, shooting them apart while dodging fragments in a faithful, stripped-down arcade loop.
